abstract: A 14-year-old male presenting with a short history of right subclavicular chest pain was found to have a mediastinal tumor. Hematologic investigations and bone marrow examination showed features of myelomonocytic leukemia. The mediastinal tumor was excised, but the surgery was complicated by massive hemorrhage. The patient's condition deteriorated postoperatively and he died a week later. The histology of the mediastinal tumor showed the typical features of an immature teratoma with a yolk sac tumor. A prominent infiltrate of leukemic blast cells was present within blood vessels and in close proximity to the yolk sac component. The karyotypic analysis of leukemic cells isolated and cultured from the bone marrow showed 50XXY, +8, +21, +iso G-group marker chromosome karyotype.
abstract_ja: 14歳の男児が、右鎖骨下部の胸痛を短期間訴えて受診し、縦隔腫瘍が認められた。血液学的検査と骨髄検査で骨髄単球性白血病の所見が示された。縦隔腫瘍は切除されたが、手術は大量出血により合併症を生じた。患者は術後に状態が悪化し、1週間後に死亡した。縦隔腫瘍の組織像は、卵黄嚢腫瘍を伴う未熟奇形腫の典型的な特徴を示した。白血病性芽球の著明な浸潤が血管内および卵黄嚢成分の近傍に認められた。骨髄から分離・培養した白血病細胞の核型解析では、50XXY, +8, +21, +iso G群マーカー染色体という核型が示された。
